description: Leray DSS search in a log-phase trial basis (arbitrary precision; numerical exploration, NOT a proof).
trial_tail: (1+rho)^-(p + i theta m w); theta=1: mode m decays like |y|^(-1-2imw)
seed: periodic C: L2N3, seeded from complex eigenmode of steady class 0 (L2N3), K-refined 2->8 (float S=0.471208)
method: secant pseudo-arclength in (x, W*theta), chord-Newton corrector; dF/dtheta by FD (h=1e-30), dF/domega = (theta/omega) dF/dtheta + i m M_m A_m
